author: MarcoNex
name: Filmic starting-point styles
description: Seven filmic rgb starting-point styles by MarcoNex for the darktable 3.0 scene-referred workflow. Each is tuned to the lighting situation in its name: normal light (plain, brighter, or without local contrast), moderate backlight, strong backlight (plain or contrasty) and extreme backlight. These are his second-generation set, which renamed and extended the four styles he shared earlier in the same thread.
